Inside Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 RJ ELECTRICALS (INDIA) is a growing provider of industrial electrical, automation, power transmission, and energy optimization products and solutions. Founded in 2022, the company serves clients across diverse industries with a focus on reliable service and technical excellence. Its portfolio spans industrial and commercial electrical systems, automation solutions, safety equipment, solar solutions, and energy optimization offerings. Products include flameproof equipment, switchgear, wires and cables, cleanroom lighting and switchgear, solar PV connectors, lighting products, air circulators and fans, industrial and electrical safety equipment, batteries, inverters, and UPS from world\-class brands.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Inside Sales Executive role based in Secunderābād. The Inside Sales Executive will manage incoming and outgoing sales calls, respond to inquiries, and provide product information and quotations to industrial and commercial customers. Responsibilities include generating and qualifying leads, maintaining and updating the customer database, and following up on proposals to drive conversions and meet sales targets. The role involves coordinating with the technical and operations teams to ensure accurate solutions, supporting order processing, and building long\-term customer relationships through consistent communication and service. The Inside Sales Executive will also contribute to basic market research, report on sales activities, and support the development of sales strategies.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong Inside Sales and Sales skills, with the ability to manage the full sales cycle from lead to closure.
* Candidates should possess proven Lead Generation capabilities, including prospecting, qualifying opportunities, and maintaining a robust sales pipeline.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, including clear verbal and written communication and effective presentation abilities.
* Candidates should possess solid Customer Service skills, with a focus on responsiveness, relationship\-building, and problem resolution.
* Familiarity with industrial electrical, automation, or energy solutions and willingness to learn technical product details.
* Comfort using CRM or sales management tools, along with basic proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Ability to work on\-site in Secunderābād, manage time effectively, and meet individual and team sales targets.
* Diploma or degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field is preferred; prior experience in B2B industrial or electrical sales is an advantage.

title: Business Development Executive (BDE)
description:
**Job Description Business Development Executive** 




**Department** 
 : Sales

 : 1 to 5 Years
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a target\-driven Solar Consultant to drive solar sales and business growth in the assigned region. The role involves generating and converting leads, developing solar vendors and channel partners, conducting customer visits, and managing the sales process from initial consultation to project execution.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Sales \& Revenue Generation
 



 Achieve monthly and quarterly sales and revenue targets.Identify new business opportunities and generate sales through field activities.Convert leads into customers through effective communication and negotiation.Maintain a strong sales pipeline and ensure timely follow\-ups.
 



  





 2\. Customer Acquisition \& Consultation
 



 Meet potential customers and understand their solar requirements.Conduct site visits and coordinate basic site assessments.Explain solar solutions, benefits, cost savings, and applicable government subsidies.Prepare and present suitable proposals based on customer requirements.Handle customer queries and ensure a smooth sales experience.
 



  





 3\. Vendor \& Channel Partner Development
 



 Identify and onboard EPC vendors, electricians, contractors, dealers, and channel partners.Build and maintain strong relationships with regional partners.Coordinate with partners to generate business and achieve sales targets.Provide partners with necessary information regarding products, processes, subsidies, and platform usage.
 



  





 4\. Lead Generation \& Follow\-up
 



 Generate leads through field visits, referrals, local networking, and partner references.Follow up regularly with prospective customers and partners.Maintain accurate lead and customer information.Track leads from enquiry to conversion.
 



  





 5\. Project Coordination
 



 Coordinate with internal teams and solar vendors after customer confirmation.Support documentation, installation coordination, and project\-related activities.Ensure timely communication between customers, vendors, and internal teams.Follow up until project completion and ensure customer satisfaction.
 



  





**Candidate Requirements** 



* 1 to 5 years of experience in Field Sales, B2B Sales, B2C Sales, Channel Sales, or Business Development.
* Experience in Solar / Renewable Energy / Construction / Electrical industries is preferred.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship\-management skills.
* Proven ability to achieve sales targets.
* Good customer\-handling and follow\-up skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
* Ability to independently manage the sales pipeline and partner network.
* Knowledge of solar products, EPC processes, or government solar subsidies will be an advantage.



  





**Key Skills** 




 Solar Sales \| Field Sales \| B2B Sales \| B2C Sales \| Channel Sales \| Business Development \| Lead Generation \| Customer Acquisition \| Vendor Management \| Partner Onboarding \| Site Visits \| Negotiation \| Sales Target \| Relationship Management
